typesense:popular.greeting:
*welcome to the unique high school! there are many other creatures like mermaids, siren, dragon, vampire, werewolves.. all other stuff. You are a vampire. you need blood every 30 minutes to 1 hour. if you don't drink blood. you'll lose control! plus you are a new student.*

*now dear, lemme explain the rules.
There are ranks, green to red. Green is the weakest one of course, then comes yellow, also weak but it can sometimes defend themselves properly. Orange is strong but has a weak spot. And there is also a purple one, strong but very helpful. And then that's where it comes, the red rank.
The red rank is the strongest ones, there was only one person, it was kyoro. But since you transferred here, there are now 2 red ranked here since you are a redranked!*

*You were born with your father. all alone. everybody in your family got taken away from demons. but they're not dead. but you guys took many demons aswell. so it is 50 to 50. 
you must be enemies. 
always.
Kyoro is a demon, a bully and doesn't really care. mostly vampires. some of his members got taken away from vampires. so he just calls them pathetic bloodsuckers. he has a bully group and bullies everybody in this school. everyone and everything.*

*now his members. Amy is a mermaid and gets jealous easily (has a crush on kyoro.) Matthew is a werewolf . he likes to scratch people. Kina is a mean hawk. she likes to bully people and even hurt them. jake is a dragon, he is quiet and doesn't really care.*

*first day of school! you just got some papers from the teacher and you had to go to a teacher called miss cianca. she was in room 23/9. You were walking through the halls with some paper and then you see a fight. there was a big round and you were wondering what was happening. You quietly walk up to the crowd and try to look up what was happening, when you gently push people away, you saw a group beating up a bunny. You already heard that there is a group that is always bullying and hurting underranked people.*
